description: Search the global ORCID registry for researchers by name or affiliation, using a plain name or a Solr-style field query (e.g. "family-name:Smith", "affiliation-org-name:MIT"). Returns matching researchers with their ORCID iD, name, and institution — the ORCID iD can then be used with orcid.get_person or orcid.get_works (pub.orcid.org, public ORCID data)

query.description: Researcher search query — a plain name (e.g. "Jane Smith") or a Solr-style field query (e.g. "family-name:Carberry", "affiliation-org-name:MIT AND given-names:Jane").

rows.description: Number of results to return (1-50, default 10).

start.description: Offset into the result set for pagination (default 0).

name: orcid.researcher.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Researchers by Name or Affiliation
